claims.sentence: You may apply for a repeated or partial Grant if you were previously expelled from the University for failing to fulfill your duties to study and complete the curriculum

You are eligible if you previously studied at the University using Grant funds that covered your tuition, or if you previously studied using federal, regional, or local budget funds and received a Grant that provided a University scholarship
You are also eligible if you were previously admitted under a target training contract within the target admission quota
You may submit your application within five years after your expulsion date, but you can receive a repeated Grant no more than once
The Grant is intended to cover tuition after you complete the restoration procedure
The decision to provide a repeated or partial Grant is based on your personal application
Your application is reviewed by a Competition Commission that is created and operates according to the Regulation
The Competition Commission may conduct separate selection tests for you as a restoring student who applied for a repeated Grant
The volume of your repeated Grant is determined by the Competition Commission
Your repeated Grant cannot exceed the percentage of tuition that was covered by your Grant before expulsion
If your previous Grant covered 71% to 100% of tuition, your repeated Grant can be no more than 70%
If your previous Grant covered 61% to 75%, your repeated Grant can be no more than 60%
If your previous Grant covered 51% to 60%, your repeated Grant can be no more than 50%
If your previous Grant covered 26% to 50%, your repeated Grant can be no more than 25%
If your previous Grant covered 25% or less, you will not be provided with a repeated Grant that covers part of your tuition
If you previously studied using federal, regional, or local budget funds and received a Grant providing a University scholarship, your repeated Grant can be no more than 75% of tuition
Based on a separate University decision, you may be provided with a Grant that provides a University scholarship if you are enrolled through restoration to budget-funded places
For persons admitted under a target training contract, the Competition Commission determines the volume of the partial Grant
You must pay the portion of tuition that is not covered by your repeated Grant in the trimester you are restored
The remaining balance is paid according to the education contract you sign when you are restored
The cost of tuition for persons admitted under a target training contract is determined according to clause 6.3 of the Regulation
The evidence does not specify the exact deadline for submitting your personal application
The evidence does not state the format or submission channel for the application
The evidence does not define the composition or selection criteria for the Competition Commission
The evidence does not explain the content or schedule of the separate selection tests
The evidence does not provide the text or details of clause 6.3 regarding target training tuition costs
The evidence does not specify how the separate University decision for budget-funded scholarship Grants is made
The evidence does not address what happens if you apply after the five-year window
The evidence does not clarify whether the repeated Grant applies to specific programs or all programs
The evidence does not state whether the Competition Commission's decisions can be appealed
The evidence does not define what constitutes "failing to fulfill your duties to study and complete the curriculum"
